stops.note: relating to Osman, founder of the Ottoman dynasty, later applied to a low cushioned seat in Ottoman style
adopted into French furniture vocabulary for the cushioned seat
stops.meaning: a low cushioned seat or footstool

stops.note: settled as the English word for the upholstered footstool
stops.meaning: an upholstered seat or footstool without a back

current_meaning: an upholstered seat or footstool without arms or a back
